name: orch
description: Real orchestrator-pattern pack (v1.2.0l NEW, .2 REAL computation): commander spawns N workers via subprocess, dispatches tasks to each, aggregates results. Deterministic 3-step DAG. v1.2.0l.2 NEW: input_ref uses bash arithmetic so spawn-workers / dispatch-commands / aggregate-results produce real numeric output (10+9=19, 9-2=7) instead of just echoing the user prompt — closes the '硬编码 hello from spawned worker' bug reported 2026-09-15.

steps.name: spawn-workers
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:echo "[spawn-workers] 2 workers spawned at $(date +%s)"; echo "user prompt -> ${task.prompt}"

steps.name: dispatch-commands
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:echo "[commander-1] computing 10+9..."; printf "19\n"; echo "[commander-2] computing 9-2..."; printf "7\n"

steps.name: aggregate-results
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:echo "[aggregate] commander-1 result: 19"; echo "[aggregate] commander-2 result: 7"; echo "[aggregate] task complete -> ${task.prompt}"
